configuration.query: What are Alex's high risk deals this year?
configuration.rephrase: The query will list out all customer deals where deal owner is Alex, risk is high, and deal date is this year
configuration.standardsql: SELECT [cr696_customerdeal].* FROM [cr696_customerdeal] JOIN [cr696_dealowner] ON [cr696_customerdeal].[cr696_dealowner] = [cr696_dealowner].[cr696_dealownerid] WHERE [cr696_dealowner].[cr696_dealownername] = 'Alex' AND [cr696_customerdeal].[cr696_risk] = 'High' AND [cr696_customerdeal].[cr696_dealdate] = 'this year'
